profile.headline: Scientific applications developer, optimizer, problem-solver
profile.jobTitle: HPC Software Architect / Software Engineer IV
profile.summary:
I'm available and eager to help with any of the following:

Software performance analysis and optimization for computationally intensive applications. Science and engineering models and simulations, data analytics. Architecture and design for performance and scalability. Improving application robustness and test capability. Benchmarking.

Deep bug diagnosis and correction.

Software development practice guidance and training. Version control. Bug tracking. Code review. Release management. Traceable deployment.

Particularly experienced with codes that involve particle in cell (PIC), adaptive mesh refinement (AMR), multicomponent, and multiphysics.

positions.title: HPC Software Architect / Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Develop the model engine and simulation code as part of NOAA's National Water Model (NWM) NextGen Framework. This will be used to provide enhanced nation-wide river-flow and flood forecasting capabilities.

Guide staff with science and engineering backgrounds on software development tools, techniques, and practices to promote productive development and robust software products.

positions.title: Principal
positions.description: Consulting on computationally intensive software applications to deliver increased business value through increased performance and scalability. Gain scientific and engineering insights not available from physical experiments, get them faster, and get them at lower cost.
positions.insights: Skills: NumPy · SciPy · Parallel Computing · Git · GitHub · Pandas (Software)

company.name: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Department of Computer Science

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description: Port the Micro-Velosity (uVelosity) embedded real-time operating system to the ARC ISA.

projects.title: WarpX
projects.description: Contribute to simulation and analysis capabilities desired by my client, Modern Electron. Focus on C++/Python interfacing, extending physics capabilities, and enhancing performance for their use cases that diverged substantially from the upstream team's focus.

publications.title: Position Paper: A Multi-resolution Emulation + Simulation Methodology
`Cool' Load Balancing for High Performance Computing Data Centers
